selection_rule: Do not tag every read or every swapin as memory pressure. Preserve struct page/bio size, existing flag numbers and all vendor-visible VM stat array dimensions.

abi_findings.page_flags: Append PG_workingset at old __NR_PAGEFLAGS (selected config bit21), rather than upstream enum reorder. Old PG_waiters remains7, PG_error remains1, PG_mlocked remains20. New generated NR_PAGEFLAGS=22 must be tested against top-down fields; core struct page has no new member.
abi_findings.bio_flags: BIO_WORKINGSET can occupy unused bit12 with existing BVEC_POOL_OFFSET=13; retain existing values1..11 and bvec pool bits13..15. Root agent owns this implementation.
abi_findings.vm_stat: Do not append even a new node_stat_item blindly: growing NR_VM_NODE_STAT_ITEMS enlarges arrays embedded in pglist_data/mem_cgroup and moves subsequent fields. Full anon statistics require private storage or deliberate ABI-preserving adaptation; no array enlargement in implemented subset.
abi_findings.remaining_blob_limit: Compiled layout/value guards prove C-level encoding preservation. They do not prove a proprietary module never applies a hard-coded all-page-flags mask; review relevant blob callsites if a real regression appears.

upstream_anon_series.title: mm/vmscan: make active/inactive ratio as 1:1 for anon lru
upstream_anon_series.role: Temporary1:1 anon ratio; cancels with final4002570, omit both when squashing.

upstream_anon_series.title: mm/vmscan: protect the workingset on anonymous LRU
upstream_anon_series.role: Semantic prerequisite: newly allocated/first-swapin anon pages start inactive; repeated-reference promotion distinguishes actual hot pages. Without this,4.19 initially-active anon pages make historical-active classification misleading.

upstream_anon_series.title: mm/workingset: prepare the workingset detection infrastructure for anon LRU
upstream_anon_series.role: Separate anon/file refault observations and inactive-list decisions. Literal patch changes VM enum and struct lruvec.refaults to array; needs private storage/adaptation, not direct application.

upstream_anon_series.title: mm/swapcache: support to handle the shadow entries
upstream_anon_series.role: Swapcache shadow install/lookup/remove and slot-free cleanup. Upstream uses XArray; current4.19 uses radix tree and nrexceptional, requiring semantic rewrite.

upstream_anon_series.title: mm/swap: implement workingset detection for anonymous LRU
upstream_anon_series.role: Connect anon eviction shadows, asynchronous swapcache reads and synchronous swapin bypass to workingset classification.

upstream_anon_series.title: mm/vmscan: restore active/inactive ratio for anonymous LRU
upstream_anon_series.role: Restores original active/inactive ratio; net with first patch is zero.

correctness_and_instrumentation.title: mm/swap: don't SetPageWorkingset unconditionally during swapin
correctness_and_instrumentation.role: Mandatory: remove unconditional swapin PageWorkingset tagging, including readahead/used-once tmpfs.

correctness_and_instrumentation.title: mm/page_io.c: annotate refault stalls from swap_readpage
correctness_and_instrumentation.role: Instrument swap_readpage synchronous CPU/decompression/submission cost, only together with d8c47 guard.

correctness_and_instrumentation.title: mm: page_io: fix psi memory pressure error on cold swapins
correctness_and_instrumentation.role: Mandatory: swap_readpage enter/leave only for PageWorkingset, preventing cold zram/zswap false memory pressure.

correctness_and_instrumentation.title: swap: check mapping_empty() for swap cache before being freed
correctness_and_instrumentation.role: Add swapoff/exit assertion that all real pages and shadows are gone before address_space destruction.

correctness_and_instrumentation.title: block: annotate refault stalls from IO submission
correctness_and_instrumentation.role: Working-set read submission cost, using ABI-safe bit12 and retaining cloned/split propagation; implemented by root.

modern_algorithm_context.title: mm: vmscan: detect file thrashing at the reclaim root
modern_algorithm_context.role: For modern5.15-equivalent cross-cgroup classification, eviction shadow records reclaim root and age propagates to ancestors. This is broader than file-only4.19 instrumentation.

modern_algorithm_context.title: mm: workingset: let cache workingset challenge anon
modern_algorithm_context.role: When file+anon compete, refault threshold includes anon only if swap is available.

modern_algorithm_context.title: mm: workingset: age nonresident information alongside anonymous pages
modern_algorithm_context.role: Required partner of expanded threshold: drive nonresident_age with anon aging as well, otherwise false recency/LRU churn. Existing inactive_age field can be retained in-place by name/type; do not add a second field.

modern_algorithm_context.title: memcg: charge before adding to swapcache on swapin
modern_algorithm_context.role: Not intrinsically required for PSI; warns that upstream has different memcg charging timing.4.19 swapcache page can lack page_memcg until do_swap_page; do not dereference it as if modern charge-before-refault ordering existed. Either adapt classification to eviction owner while preserving old charging, or coherently port charge/cancel/error handling.

modern_algorithm_context.title: mm/swap: optimise get_shadow_from_swap_cache
modern_algorithm_context.role: Optimization only;4.19 can retain safe find_get_entry/exceptional check and put_page for real entries instead of importing xa_load.

radix_tree_adaptation_contract: Retain existing exported add_to_swap_cache and __delete_from_swap_cache signatures if present in Module.symvers; add private shadow-aware helpers and compatibility wrappers, updating only core callers.

On swap reclaim, replace the existing radix-tree page slot with exceptional shadow under address_space i_pages lock; do not delete then allocate a fresh node in atomic reclaim. Update node exceptional counts and address_space.nrexceptional exactly once.

On swapcache insertion, recognize shadow as replaceable rather than EEXIST, return it to classifier, reduce nrexceptional, retain page refs/SwapCache/private fields. For multi-page insert failure, preserve or restore replaced shadows and roll back all partially inserted page slots.

Clear every shadow in swap_range_free before the slot can be reallocated to unrelated data. Split cleanup at SWAP_ADDRESS_SPACE_SHIFT boundaries; never iterate a radix_tree while freeing its current node without its supported iterator restart rules.

Swapoff exit must leave zero pages and zero exceptional entries. Do not attach swapper address_space shadows to file-cache shadow_nodes shrinker unless its lifetime/locking contract is deliberately extended.
Both __read_swap_cache_async and SWP_SYNCHRONOUS_IO do_swap_page bypass must restore classification before swap_readpage; otherwise zram and disk backends diverge.
Remove file-only guards in filemap/vmscan only after proper anon new-page policy, shadow classification and cold-swap guard are present together.

Do not import full XArray merely to apply3852 literally; existing4.19 radix-tree exceptional infrastructure can implement the required state transitions with unchanged struct page/bio/address_space layouts.
test_requirements: Cold file read with ample memory: IO PSI increases, memory PSI remains near baseline; hot cache refault under reclaim must increase memory PSI above v7.
Cold first swapin/readahead vs repeated hot anonymous refault, on raw swap, swapfile, zram and zswap; guard must make classification consistent across backends.
Swap slot reuse, swapoff under load, reclaim memcg deletion/ID reuse, swap read error and allocation failure, interrupted waits, compound page migration/split.
No LRU aging regression: compare major faults, anon/file refault counts and throughput with mixed hot anon/cold sequential file workload.
ABI probes must assert all pre-existing page/bio flags, zone/node/section offsets, NR_VM_* counts and sizeof/offsetof(page,bio,pglist_data,lruvec,mem_cgroup) unchanged.
decision: Ship only after full build and A/B validation. File subset is already implemented rather than merely recommended. Full anonymous/swap classification is feasible but crosses LRU admission, swapcache lifetime and memcg charge assumptions; it is not represented as completed by adding a lone swap_readpage hook.
